'''Jardra''' was a [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the daughter of [[Chop Harlison]] and his wife, [[Sharda]]. Jardra was the lead singer of the band called "[[Hyperspaze and the Jump Lanes]]." She wrote most of the band's lyrics as well, together with fellow band member [[Ballifore Figg]].
